detailEn: United States GP: Lewis Hamilton fastest from Max Verstappen in final practice ahead of Qualifying in Austin

Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton outpaced Red Bull's Max Verstappen in final practice in Austin with Friday's pace-setter Charles Leclerc in third; watch every United States GP session live on Sky Sports F1, with qualifying at 10pm on Saturday and the race at 8pm on Sunday
Lewis Hamilton claims the fastest lap from Max Verstappen in final practice at the United States Grand Prix
Lewis Hamilton topped final practice from Max Verstappen at the United States Grand Prix to set up a tantalising qualifying in Austin.
Hamilton was 0.168s quicker than Verstappen as Ferrari and Red Bull look set to fight for pole position and victory for a second consecutive weekend.
Charles Leclerc topped both of Friday's sessions and had set the quickest time in final practice by one tenth from Hamilton, only for it to be deleted due to track limits.

Track limits is set to be a major issue for the drivers in qualifying, which takes place at 10pm UK time later on Saturday (build-up from 8.30pm live on Sky Sports F1 and Main Event) due to the tarmac run-off areas and the drivers keen to use every bit of track to gain lap time.

Leclerc still finished the session in third, ahead of championship leader Kimi Antonelli whose chances of becoming the youngest world champion look extremely difficult, given he must first win the Grand Prix to give himself an opportunity, and Mercedes are a tad off the pace.
Antonelli was three tenths behind Hamilton's pace-setting time with his Mercedes team-mate George Russell in fifth at nearly half a second down.

McLaren's Lando Norris was eighth but would have been in the top five had his best lap not been deleted for track limit, while Oscar Piastri was sixth and Audi's Nico Hulkenberg impressing in seventh.

items.summaryZh: 汉密尔顿在美国大奖赛的最后练习赛中排名第一，领先维斯塔潘和勒克莱尔进入排位赛。汉密尔顿是唯一在最后20分钟打破1分35秒大关的车手，频繁的越界让法拉利队友勒克莱尔无法超越他。

items.originalTitle: F1 United States GP: Lewis Hamilton pips Max Verstappen in FP3
detailZh: F1美国大奖赛：汉密尔顿在FP3中险胜维斯塔潘
法拉利在COTA的每节练习中都排名第一，进入排位赛
汉密尔顿在F1美国大奖赛的最后一节练习中排名第一，领先维斯塔潘和勒克莱尔进入奥斯汀的排位赛
在第三节的最后20分钟里，汉密尔顿是唯一打破1分35秒大关的车手，频繁的越界行为使得法拉利队友勒克莱尔无法超越他登上排行榜。
本节练习的前三圈只能用平淡无奇来形容，但随着汉密尔顿在软胎上跑出1分36.716秒，超越了多个使用中等轮胎的圈速。
不久后，小红牛车队和迈凯轮的利亚姆·劳森打破了汉密尔顿的成绩，而几位重量级选手仍在使用中等轮胎进行圈速测试。
尽管范斯特appen对换挡时的不稳定状态有所抱怨，但他凭借黄色侧壁轮胎的1分35.702秒成绩名列前茅。
汉密尔顿迅速提升了成绩，使用软胎跑出了1分35.561秒。但勒克莱尔尽管使用的是较慢的中胎，却以1分35.127秒的成绩接管了领先位置，这表明还有更多的速度可以挖掘。
进入最后20分钟，安东内利在软胎上比勒克莱尔快了十分之一，但他在9号弯道超出了赛道限制，导致这一圈被取消。
维斯塔潘遵守了白线，以1分35.061秒的成绩排名第一，红牛车队在第一区段是最快的，但汉密尔顿的成绩低于1分35秒，达到了1分34.893秒。
在整个练习过程中一直出现的赛道限制问题，也阻止了勒克莱尔重新夺回第一的位置，因为他在10号弯道越过了白线。
这意味着摩纳哥车手只能满足于排在汉密尔顿和维斯塔潘之后，为周六下午的排位赛设置了一场紧张激烈的局面。
冠军车手安东内利排在第四位，领先于梅赛德斯车队的队友乔治·拉塞尔，银箭车队似乎在纯速度上落后半步，皮亚斯蒂在难以驾驭的MCL40中排在第六位。
在奥迪车队，尼科·胡肯伯格阻止了麦克拉伦车队的兰多·诺里斯获得第七名，世界冠军的1分35.2秒成绩也因为第十弯的赛道限制而被取消。
阿尔派车队的皮埃尔·加斯利排在第九位，落后汉密尔顿一秒，伊萨克·哈德贾在第二辆小红牛车队中排在第十位，这位法国车手因为他的赛车操控问题而感到沮丧。
detailEn: F1 United States GP: Lewis Hamilton pips Max Verstappen in FP3
Ferrari heads into qualifying having topped every practice session at COTA
Lewis Hamilton finished final practice on top at Formula 1's United States Grand Prix, leading Max Verstappen and Charles Leclerc into qualifying at Austin.

Hamilton was the only driver to break the 1m35s barrier in the final 20 minutes of third practice, as frequent track limits transgressions kept Ferrari team-mate Leclerc from leapfrogging him on the leaderboard.
Following an opening quarter of the session which can only be described as pedestrian, action picked up as Hamilton set a 1m36.716s on softs to get ahead of a number of medium-tyred install laps.
His time was soon beaten by Liam Lawson in the Racing Bulls and McLaren's Oscar Piastri, while several heavy hitters kept turning laps on medium tyres instead.
Verstappen even went top courtesy of a 1m35.702s on the yellow sidewall tyre, despite recurring complaints about his unsettling downshifts.

Hamilton swiftly improved upon the Dutchman's lap, using softs to set a 1m35.561s. But when Leclerc took over command with a 1m35.127s despite using the slower mediums, that underlined there was still a lot more pace to find.
Entering the final 20 minutes, Antonelli took a tenth out of Leclerc's time on softs, but his lap was scratched for breaking track limits at Turn 9.
Verstappen did adhere to the white lines to set a 1m35.061s and go top, with Red Bull the quickest car through sector one, only for Hamilton to dip below the 1m35s barrier with a 1m34.893s.
Track limits, which have been a recurring theme throughout practice, also kept Leclerc from reclaiming first as he dipped over the white line at Turn 10.
That meant the Monegasque had to settle for third behind Hamilton and Verstappen, setting up a finely poised qualifying session on Saturday afternoon.

Championship leader Antonelli was fourth ahead of Mercedes team-mate George Russell, as the Silver Arrows appears to be a half-step behind on pure pace, with Piastri sixth in the difficult to tame MCL40.
In the Audi, Nico Hulkenberg kept McLaren’s Lando Norris from seventh, with the world champion’s 1m35.2s also deleted for track limits at Turn 10.
Alpine driver Pierre Gasly was ninth, a full second behind Hamilton, with Isack Hadjar 10th in the second Red Bull as the Frenchman was left frustrated by his car's handling.
keyPointsZh: 勒克莱尔因越界无法超越汉密尔顿
keyPointsEn: Leclerc could not overtake Hamilton due to track limits transgressions

items.titleZh: 法拉利完成美国大奖赛练习赛全胜
items.summaryZh: 法拉利在美国大奖赛的最后一场练习赛中完成了全部的顶尖成绩，尽管查尔斯·勒克莱尔因超车限界被删除成绩，但最终是刘易斯·汉密尔顿位居第一。
items.originalTitle: Ferrari completes US GP practice sweep
detailZh: 法拉利在奥斯汀的最终练习赛中完成了美国大奖赛的一整套顶尖F1练习时间，尽管查尔斯·勒克莱尔因为超车限界被扣除时间，这次是刘易斯·汉密尔顿位居第一。
周五的领跑者勒克莱尔失去了比汉密尔顿快0.083秒的时间，因此跌至第三，排在马克斯·维斯塔潘之后，因为他不得不依靠中胎时间。
在车队转向排位赛模拟之前，法拉利在练习赛的第一部分的长距离跑中也一直处于领先地位。
汉密尔顿对加布里埃尔·博尔特莱托在练习赛中发生的交通事件表示了不满——这是当节练习中众多事件之一， stewards 将会对此进行调查。
勒克莱尔并非唯一违反赛道的车手，整个练习赛中， 删除，指因违反规则而取消圈速的数量惊人。车手积分榜领跑者基米·安东内利和两位麦克拉伦车手也成为了其他引人注目的违规者。
勒克莱尔的圈速损失意味着红牛车队以维斯塔潘的成绩结束练习赛，排在第二位，他和伊萨克·哈德贾在车队无线电中（亚历克斯·阿隆索也受到了哈德贾的指责）有很多抱怨，维斯塔潘在练习赛结束时经历了一次疯狂的锁死、滑动和打滑。
安东内利最终排在第四位，领先于他的梅赛德斯车队队友乔治·拉塞尔。
圈速删除帮助尼克·胡肯伯格将奥迪车队提升至第七位，分开了两辆麦克拉伦赛车。
12 小红牛（小红牛）车手林德布拉德 +1.188秒
16 阿斯顿·马丁车手阿隆索 +1.562秒
detailEn: Ferrari completed a full set of top United States Grand Prix Formula 1 practice times in the final session at Austin, though a track limits deletion for Charles Leclerc meant this time it was Lewis Hamilton on top.
Friday pacesetter Leclerc lost a time that had been 0.083 seconds faster than Hamilton, falling to third behind Max Verstappen as a result as he had to rely on a medium-tyre time.
Ferrari had also been on top during the longer runs in the first part of the session before teams switched to qualifying simulations.
Hamilton expressed his frustration with Gabriel Bortoleto over a traffic incident - one of quite a few in the session - that will be looked at by the stewards.

Leclerc was far from the only driver to fall foul of track limits as the wild number of laptime deletions continued through the session. Championship leader Kimi Antonelli and both McLaren drivers were among the other high-profile transgressors.

Though Leclerc's lap loss meant Red Bull ended the session second with Verstappen, both he and Isack Hadjar had plenty of complaints over team radio (with Alex Albon also getting Hadjar's ire) and Verstappen having a wild lock-up, slide and wheelspin moment to end his session.
Antonelli ended up fourth ahead of Mercedes team-mate George Russell.
The laptime deletions helped Nico Hulkenberg to get Audi as high as seventh, splitting the McLarens.
12 Arvid Lindblad (Racing Bulls) +1.188s
16 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +1.562s
keyPointsZh: 勒克莱尔因超车限界被删除成绩，汉密尔顿以0.083秒的优势位居第一。
法拉利在练习赛的前半段表现优异。
勒克莱尔对交通事件表示不满， stewards 将对此进行调查。
keyPointsEn: Leclerc's lap time was deleted due to track limits, with Hamilton taking the top spot by 0.083 seconds.
Ferrari had a strong performance in the first part of the session.
Leclerc expressed frustration over a traffic incident that stewards will investigate.
